svg.title: Perfboard layout, one XIAO ESP32-C3 channel
svg.desc: A XIAO ESP32-C3 controller for one Mean Well driver on a 20 by 18 hole piece of 2.54 mm perfboard. Component side: XIAO on female headers at the top left with USB-C at the top edge, knob header J4 on the left edge, DS18B20 header J3, 5 V input terminal J1 and driver terminal J2 along the bottom edge, R1 1 kOhm, R2 10 kOhm, R3 4.7 kOhm, Q1 BC547 and C1 100 uF. Solder side: the same board flipped left to right with every wire coloured by net.
svg.text: Perfboard prototype: one XIAO ESP32-C3, one driver
parts on top · dashed lines are the wires underneath
Solder side (board flipped left to right)
wires and solder joints · build from this view
Grey joints on the XIAO are unused pins: solder the header pin but run no wire to it. Resistor bodies and the XIAO bridge over the wires below them.
Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3, on 2 × 1×7 female headers
BC547 NPN, flat face toward the bottom edge
or 2N7000: same holes, flat face toward the top,
1 kΩ ¼ W, PWM to base
10 kΩ ¼ W, base to 3.3 V (light off at boot)
100 µF 10 V electrolytic, 2.5 mm pitch, optional
2-way screw terminal 5.08 mm, to DIM+ / DIM−
1×4 right-angle header, knob (CLK · DT · SW · GND)
tinned copper wire 0.5 mm for the wires
Solder the two female headers first. Never solder the XIAO
flat on the board: the PWM and 3.3 V wires run under it.
Lay the wires on the solder side as drawn. That view is
mirrored, so J4 is on the right when the board is flipped.
Fit R1–R3, Q1, C1 (stripe = −), the headers and terminals.
Before plugging in the XIAO, check with a meter:
no short between 5 V, 3.3 V and GND, and none between
neighbouring wires. J2 DIM+ to DIM− should read open.
Power from J1 or from USB-C, never both at once.
J2: DIM+ to DIM+, DIM− to DIM−. Never the LED output.
Settings → Channels: tick Invert, Min % 8 (XLG) or 6 (HLG).
The knob and 1-Wire pins already match the xiao-c3 build.
A KY-040 module’s + pin can stay unconnected.
Relay: D7 is free; wire a module to it by hand if needed.
